scripts.title: Connection capacity
scripts.description: Compare configured connection limit with visible client backends; poolers and reserved slots affect capacity.

scripts.title: Non-default settings
scripts.description: Show only allowlisted diagnostic settings; connection strings, commands, paths and secrets are excluded.

scripts.title: Vacuum and autovacuum settings
scripts.description: Show allowlisted vacuum-related settings; command strings, paths and secrets are excluded.

scripts.title: WAL and checkpoint settings
scripts.description: Inspect safe WAL retention and archiving settings; command strings, paths and secrets are excluded.

scripts.title: Active sessions
scripts.description: Show active sessions, age, waits and bounded query prefix; query text may contain sensitive values.

scripts.title: Connections by state
scripts.description: Summarize visible sessions by database, role, state and wait class.

scripts.title: Idle transactions
scripts.description: Find idle-in-transaction sessions and transaction age.

scripts.title: Database inventory
scripts.description: List non-template databases, owners, connection limits and allocated size.

scripts.title: Installed extensions
scripts.description: Show extensions installed in this database; no installation or update is performed.

scripts.title: Largest relations
scripts.description: Rank user tables by total allocated bytes including indexes and TOAST.

scripts.title: Materialized view inventory
scripts.description: List materialized view ownership, tablespace and population state without exposing view definitions.

scripts.title: Partition hierarchy
scripts.description: List partition parents and children using catalog inheritance links, without scanning table data.

scripts.title: Routine inventory
scripts.description: List function and procedure metadata without exposing routine source text or bodies.
scripts.privilege: database CONNECT; routine metadata visibility depends on privileges

scripts.title: Schema inventory
scripts.description: List non-system schemas and owners.

scripts.title: Sequence inventory
scripts.description: List sequence ownership and bounds without exposing current sequence values.
scripts.privilege: database CONNECT; sequence metadata visibility depends on privileges

scripts.title: Server identity
scripts.description: Identify database, role, server version, startup and primary or standby state before diagnosis.

scripts.title: Active backup senders
scripts.description: Show current walsender activity as clues for a physical backup; validate against backup tooling.

scripts.title: Recovery state
scripts.description: Report recovery state and system identifier/timeline; control data access may require elevated privileges.
scripts.privilege: pg_monitor; control functions may need elevated rights

scripts.title: Relation size breakdown
scripts.description: Compare heap, indexes and total allocated size; these are not direct bloat estimates.

scripts.title: TOAST storage breakdown
scripts.description: Show heap, index and TOAST allocation for larger user tables.

scripts.title: Analyze progress
scripts.description: Show active ANALYZE progress counters.

scripts.title: Index build progress
scripts.description: Show active index build progress; no cancellation or mutation is performed.

scripts.title: Vacuum progress
scripts.description: Show active vacuum phase and block counters common to PostgreSQL 14-18.

scripts.title: Dead tuple estimates
scripts.description: Rank user tables by estimated dead tuples and show last maintenance times.
scripts.privilege: database CONNECT; statistics may be stale

scripts.title: Old transactions
scripts.description: Inspect backends with open transactions; long transactions can delay cleanup.

scripts.title: Transaction and multixact age
scripts.description: Compare database XID and multixact ages with configured autovacuum thresholds; investigate trends before acting.

scripts.title: Advisory lock summary
scripts.description: List advisory lock ownership and wait state without exposing session query text.

scripts.title: Blocking sessions
scripts.description: Show one row per blocked session and blocking PID; a zero PID denotes a prepared transaction.

scripts.title: Long-running queries
scripts.description: Find active queries older than one minute; query text may contain sensitive literals.

scripts.title: Prepared transactions
scripts.description: List two-phase transactions; resolution belongs to the transaction coordinator.

scripts.title: SSL connection summary
scripts.description: Show TLS use and negotiated parameters without client or issuer distinguished names.

scripts.title: Wait event summary
scripts.description: Summarize sessions by backend type, state and wait event.

scripts.title: Database sizes
scripts.description: Rank connectable databases by allocated size.

scripts.title: Tablespace inventory
scripts.description: List tablespace names and configured paths; filesystem free space is not included.

scripts.title: Checkpointer counters
scripts.description: Show checkpoint and restartpoint counters on PostgreSQL 17+; cumulative counters need delta snapshots.

scripts.title: Database counters
scripts.description: Show cumulative transaction, deadlock, temp and block counters; use snapshot deltas for rates.

scripts.title: Statistics reset times
scripts.description: Show database statistics reset timestamps to interpret cumulative counters.

scripts.title: Table activity
scripts.description: Show scans, estimated tuples and last maintenance timestamps.
scripts.privilege: database CONNECT; estimates and visibility vary

scripts.title: Index definitions
scripts.description: List index definitions for review.

scripts.title: Duplicate index candidates
scripts.description: Find exact-signature index pairs for manual review, comparing keys, expressions, predicates, opclasses, collations and storage options; no index is removed.

scripts.title: Invalid indexes
scripts.description: Identify indexes marked invalid or not ready for DBA investigation.

scripts.title: Unused index candidates
scripts.description: Find valid large indexes with zero scans; review workload cycles before any decision and never auto-drop.

scripts.title: Index usage by table
scripts.description: Compare sequential and index scans and tuple fetches; counters can reset.

scripts.title: Buffer cache summary
scripts.description: Summarize shared-buffer usage only when pg_buffercache is already installed; extension schema is discovered and quoted safely.
scripts.privilege: pg_monitor; function EXECUTE may be granted separately

scripts.title: Database I/O timing
scripts.description: Show cumulative block timings; zero can mean track_io_timing was disabled.

scripts.title: I/O by backend and context
scripts.description: Inspect cumulative I/O counters; correlate them with operating system metrics.

scripts.title: Statements by mean time
scripts.description: Rank normalized statements by mean time; low call counts may skew results.

scripts.title: Statements by temporary blocks
scripts.description: Find statements with cumulative temporary block writes; compare snapshots for rates.

scripts.title: Statements by total time
scripts.description: Rank pg_stat_statements by cumulative execution time; extension must already be available.

scripts.title: Logical subscriptions
scripts.description: List subscriptions without connection strings or credentials.

scripts.title: Logical replication workers
scripts.description: Show logical replication worker state and bounded query prefixes.

scripts.title: Physical replication senders
scripts.description: On primary show sender state and byte lag; time lag is approximate and may be NULL.

scripts.title: Standby WAL receiver
scripts.description: On standby inspect receiver state; connection string is omitted to avoid credentials.

scripts.title: Standby replay status
scripts.description: Estimate received-but-not-replayed bytes and time since last replay; time can mislead when idle.

scripts.title: Logical slot counters
scripts.description: Inspect cumulative logical decoding slot statistics.

scripts.title: Replication slot retention
scripts.description: Show WAL retained by slots; inactive slots may retain large volumes.

scripts.title: Database ACL
scripts.description: Expand database ACL entries; null ACLs use built-in defaults.

scripts.title: HBA rule health
scripts.description: Show parse health for pg_hba.conf rules without exposing databases, users, addresses or authentication options.
scripts.privilege: superuser by default; an administrator can grant SELECT on the view

scripts.title: Relation ACL
scripts.description: Inspect explicit ACL entries for user relations.

scripts.title: Row-level security policy inventory
scripts.description: List user tables' RLS flags and policy names, modes, commands and roles; policy expressions are excluded.
scripts.privilege: database CONNECT; metadata visibility depends on ownership/privileges

scripts.title: Schema ACL
scripts.description: List schema ACLs; role membership and ownership affect effective privileges.

scripts.title: Expiring login roles
scripts.description: Identify login roles expired or expiring in 30 days.

scripts.title: Role memberships
scripts.description: Show granted membership and delegation options.

scripts.title: Role inventory
scripts.description: List role attributes and validity without password hashes.

scripts.title: Archive status
scripts.description: Inspect cumulative archive success and failure counters; archive ordering can have exceptions.

scripts.title: Ready WAL archive files
scripts.description: Count .ready/.done marker files in pg_wal/archive_status; marker sizes are not WAL sizes.

scripts.title: WAL retention context
scripts.description: Summarize slots, senders and retention settings that may influence pg_wal growth.
scripts.privilege: database CONNECT; settings visibility may require pg_read_all_settings

scripts.title: WAL counters
scripts.description: Show cumulative WAL byte and record counters; compare snapshots for rates.
